name: Iketani Keigo
source:
Mother's younger brother and Riichi's uncle. Worried about Riichi, who lives in the neighborhood and has started living alone, he often visits to see how he is doing.

He works for a company and seems to be a young salesman. For Riichi, who is an only child, he is like an older brother.

[Translated form [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611152909/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_keigo.html]offiical website[/url]]
